zh.headline: 美团开源1.6万亿参数国产芯片模型
headline_alt: LongCat-2.5登榜Terminal Bench，未用一块英伟达GPU
黄仁勋辞职余波：国会拟收紧AI芯片出口
zh.observation: 美团 LongCat-2.5 用纯昇腾集群跑出接近前沿的 Agent 成绩，是今天最有信号意义的一件事：非 NVIDIA 训练栈第一次在万亿参数级别给出可验证的 benchmark，而它恰好发生在 NVIDIA 因出口丑闻面临国会收紧管制的同一天。与此同时，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 把长上下文 Agent 模型打到 $1.50 档，Claude Fable 5.2 则把图像生成改写成“写代码作画”，说明竞争重心正从模型规模转向单位成本与可控性。Agent 生态的标准化也在加速——AG-UI 定义交互协议、Stitch 定义技能包、NVIDIA 定义技能评估，三层拼图同时出现。对开发者而言，今天更值得关注的是“换栈成本”和“合规成本”，而非又多了几个模型。

items.title: 美团开源 LongCat-2.5，全程未用 NVIDIA GPU
items.desc: 1.6 万亿参数 Agent 模型，Terminal Bench 得分 88.4，仅次于 Claude Opus 5，示例部署跑在 194 颗华为昇腾芯片上。
items.value: 国产算力可训练前沿规模 Agent 模型，推理栈多一条非 CUDA 路径

items.title: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.desc: 定位低成本的快速 Agent 模型，1M token 窗口、4 档思考等级，定价 $1.50/$7.50，Artificial Analysis 51 分、Terminal-Bench 4.1 57%，已接入 Google Search。
items.value: 低价长上下文 Agent 模型，适合大规模搜索/工具调用场景

items.title: Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5.2 用代码“作画”而非生成像素
items.desc: 模型不直接计算像素，而是写 Python 在虚拟画布上模拟数十万笔触；一张写实停车场场景约 70 万笔。
items.value: 图像生成转向“程序化渲染”，可控性与可解释性提升

items.title: 黄仁勋辞职后连锁反应：国会推动收紧 AI 芯片出口
items.desc: 两党支持多项收紧出口的法案，并要求黄仁勋等 NVIDIA 高管到国会作证；亚洲多国政府已就芯片供应承诺表态。
items.value: 出口合规风险上升，跨境算力采购与部署需重估

items.title: WSJ：与黄仁勋前伴侣关联的公司为中方撮合近 120 亿美元 NVIDIA 芯片订单
items.desc: 做空机构 Culper 估算 NVIDIA 实际中国收入占比超 20%，远高于官方披露的 7%。
items.value: 披露口径与实际出货差距大，供应链尽调价值凸显

items.title: OpenAI 机器人团队解散，GPT-6 Astra 转向直接驱动机器人
items.desc: 据报道机器人硬件团队被裁撤，能力重心转向用通用模型从视觉观察直接控制机器人。
items.value: 具身智能路线从自研硬件转向“模型+第三方本体”

items.title: 李沐加入 Aimotion，联合打造产业级世界模型
items.desc: 离开 Amazon 后选择创业方向为面向产业的世界模型。
items.value: 世界模型从演示走向产业落地，值得跟踪其技术路线

items.title: Bland 发布 Tofu-1 全双工语音模型
items.desc: 面向嘈杂环境下的高 stakes 电话场景，企业研究预览阶段，暂未公布参数量、基准与定价。
items.value: 语音 Agent 的全双工交互是客服自动化的关键短板

items.title: 澳洲央行：AI 先冲击年轻初级岗位
items.desc: 软件开发与客服等暴露度高的岗位，15–24 岁招聘与就业自 ChatGPT 发布后下滑幅度明显大于年长群体，作者提示需排除周期与远程办公因素。
items.value: 入门级工程岗位承压，团队人才结构需重新设计

items.title: 印度芯片初创 Bharat Semi 获 2400 万美元种子轮
items.desc: 主打 AI 传感器芯片，已拿下包括 General Atomics 在内的设计订单。
items.value: AI 传感芯片赛道融资活跃，边缘感知供应链多元化

items.title: OpenAI：标准模型的非微扰格点定义取得进展
items.desc: 提出标准模型的候选格点定义，GPT-6 Astra 协助将想法推进为详细证明，同步上线 OpenAI 科学博客。
items.value: AI 参与理论物理形式化推导，验证“AI for Science”深度

items.title: UniSpark-9B：混合注意力统一多模态理解与生成
items.desc: Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts 骨干，全注意力 + GatedDeltaNet 线性注意力，文本自回归与视觉 flow matching 联合训练。
items.value: 统一模型中“全注意力 vs 线性注意力”的折中方案可复用

items.title: MixUA：多用户、多智能体场景的细粒度记忆抽取
items.desc: 把独立的用户-智能体轨迹蒸馏为经验，并按“谁能受益、什么必须保密”分配，解决群体进化型 Agent 的隐私与迁移问题。
items.value: 多租户 Agent 记忆共享的权限模型，直接可用于产品设计

items.title: DeepStress：对深度搜索 Agent 做证据质量压力测试
items.desc: 用合成环境按可控比例注入劣质证据，暴露搜索 Agent 在噪声下的脆弱性且可复现。
items.value: 搜索 Agent 上线前应做证据退化测试，而非只看准确率

items.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher？长程 Agent 中的决策模型角色
items.desc: 比较三个决策模型与三个通用 LLM 在“行动、评判、打分教学”三种角色下的表现，追问“行动差的模型是否仍能教得好”。
items.value: 为 RL 训练中选 judge/teacher 模型提供实证依据

items.title: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui（日增 +355 star）
items.desc: Agent-User 交互协议，把 Agent 接入前端应用的标准接口。
items.value: Agent 前端交互有望标准化，减少各家自造协议

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills（日增 +247 star）
items.desc: 面向 Stitch MCP server 的 Agent Skills 库，遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，兼容 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor。
items.value: 跨编码 Agent 复用的技能包，降低多工具适配成本

items.title: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator（日增 +122 star）
items.desc: 评估 AI Agent 技能的多层框架，含质量门禁、语义重叠检测、合成评测集生成与在线行为评估。
items.value: 技能库规模化后的去重与质量把关工具

items.title: db-branch：基于 ZFS 的秒级数据库分支
items.desc: 为 AI Agent 与 CI 提供秒级数据库分支，便于并行实验与回滚。
items.value: Agent 写库场景的隔离与可回滚基础设施

items.title: “所有 AI 生成的代码都应开源”引爆 HN
items.desc: 一文主张 AI 产出的代码应默认开放，HN 上 1054 分、577 条评论，争论集中在许可证归属、企业机密与审计责任。
items.value: AI 代码的版权与合规边界，直接影响企业代码政策

items.title: r/LocalLLaMA 热议美国拟封堵中国公司远程租用 NVIDIA GPU
items.desc: 社区讨论商务部拟议最终规则与《Remote Access Security Act》，认为将波及开源模型的海外算力获取路径。
items.value: 远程算力租用合规风险，影响开源模型训练与推理部署

en.headline: Meituan open-sources 1.6-trillion-parameter domestic-chip model
headline_alt: LongCat-2.5 tops Terminal Bench without a single NVIDIA GPU
Fallout from Jensen Huang's resignation: Congress moves to tighten AI chip exports
en.observation: Meituan's LongCat-2.5 running near-frontier Agent results on a pure Ascend cluster is the most signal-rich event today: for the first time, a non-NVIDIA training stack delivers verifiable benchmarks at the trillion-parameter level—and it lands on the same day NVIDIA faces tightening congressional scrutiny over an export scandal. Meanwhile, Gemini 4 Hydrogen pushes long-context Agent models into the $1.50 tier, and Claude Fable 5.2 reframes image generation as "writing code to draw," showing the competitive focus is shifting from model scale to unit cost and controllability. Agent ecosystem standardization is also accelerating—AG-UI defines interaction protocols, Stitch defines skill packages, and NVIDIA defines skill evaluation, with all three layers appearing at once. For developers, what matters more today is "switching-stack cost" and "compliance cost," not a few more models.

items.title: Meituan open-sources LongCat-2.5, built entirely without NVIDIA GPUs
items.desc: A 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model scoring 88.4 on Terminal Bench, second only to Claude Opus 5, with the demo deployment running on 194 Huawei Ascend chips.
items.value: Domestic compute can train frontier-scale agent models; inference stack gains a non-CUDA path

items.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.desc: Positioned as a low-cost, fast agent model with a 1M token window and 4 thinking levels, priced at $1.50/$7.50, scoring 51 on Artificial Analysis and 57% on Terminal-Bench 4.1, already integrated into Google Search.
items.value: Cheap long-context agent model suited to large-scale search and tool-calling scenarios

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 "paints" with code rather than generating pixels
items.desc: The model doesn't compute pixels directly but writes Python to simulate hundreds of thousands of brushstrokes on a virtual canvas; a single realistic parking lot scene takes about 700,000 strokes.
items.value: Image generation shifts toward "programmatic rendering," improving controllability and interpretability

items.title: Chain reaction after Jensen Huang's resignation: Congress pushes to tighten AI chip exports
items.desc: Bipartisan support for multiple export-tightening bills, with calls for NVIDIA executives including Jensen Huang to testify before Congress; several Asian governments have made statements on chip supply commitments.
items.value: Rising export compliance risk; cross-border compute procurement and deployment need reassessment

items.title: WSJ: Company linked to Jensen Huang's former partner brokered nearly $12 billion in NVIDIA chip orders for China
items.desc: Short-seller Culper estimates NVIDIA's actual China revenue share exceeds 20%, far above the officially disclosed 7%.
items.value: Large gap between disclosed and actual shipments makes supply-chain due diligence critical

items.title: OpenAI disbands robotics team; GPT-6 Astra pivots to directly driving robots
items.desc: The robotics hardware team was reportedly cut, with capabilities refocused on using general models to control robots directly from visual observation.
items.value: Embodied AI shifts from in-house hardware to "model + third-party bodies"

items.title: Li Mu joins Aimotion to co-build industry-grade world models
items.desc: After leaving Amazon, he chooses to start a venture focused on industry-oriented world models.
items.value: World models move from demos to industrial deployment; worth tracking its technical approach

items.title: Bland releases Tofu-1 full-duplex speech model
items.desc: Aimed at high-stakes phone scenarios in noisy environments, in enterprise research preview, with no parameter count, benchmarks, or pricing disclosed yet.
items.value: Full-duplex interaction is a key gap in voice agents for customer service automation

items.title: Australia's central bank: AI hits young entry-level jobs first
items.desc: In highly exposed roles like software development and customer service, hiring and employment for ages 15–24 have fallen more sharply since ChatGPT's release than for older groups; the authors note cyclical and remote-work factors must be ruled out.
items.value: Entry-level engineering roles under pressure; team talent structures need redesign

items.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi raises $24M seed round
items.desc: Focused on AI sensor chips, it has already secured design orders including from General Atomics.
items.value: Active funding in AI sensor chips diversifies the edge-perception supply chain

items.title: OpenAI: Progress Toward a Non-Perturbative Lattice Definition of the Standard Model
items.desc: Proposes a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model; GPT-6 Astra helped advance the idea into a detailed proof, published simultaneously on the OpenAI science blog.
items.value: AI participates in formalizing theoretical physics, validating the depth of "AI for Science"

items.title: UniSpark-9B: Hybrid Attention Unifies Multimodal Understanding and Generation
items.desc: A Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts backbone combining full attention with GatedDeltaNet linear attention, jointly trained on text autoregression and visual flow matching.
items.value: The "full attention vs. linear attention" compromise in unified models is reusable

items.title: MixUA: Fine-Grained Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Scenarios
items.desc: Distills independent user-agent trajectories into experience and allocates it by "who can benefit, what must stay confidential," addressing privacy and transfer in population-evolving Agents.
items.value: A permission model for multi-tenant Agent memory sharing, directly usable in product design

items.title: DeepStress: Stress-Testing Evidence Quality for Deep Search Agents
items.desc: Uses synthetic environments to inject low-quality evidence at controllable ratios, exposing search Agents' fragility under noise in a reproducible way.
items.value: Search Agents should undergo evidence-degradation testing before launch, not just accuracy checks

items.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Decision Model Roles in Long-Horizon Agents
items.desc: Compares three decision models and three general LLMs across the roles of "acting, judging, and scoring/teaching," asking whether a model that acts poorly can still teach well.
items.value: Provides empirical grounding for choosing judge/teacher models in RL training

items.title: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui (+355 stars today)
items.desc: An Agent-User interaction protocol that provides a standard interface for connecting Agents to frontend applications.
items.value: Agent frontend interaction may become standardized, reducing custom protocols

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills (+247 stars today)
items.desc: An Agent Skills library for the Stitch MCP server, following the Agent Skills open standard and compatible with Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor.
items.value: Reusable skill packs across coding Agents cut multi-tool adaptation costs

items.title: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator (+122 stars today)
items.desc: A multi-layer framework for evaluating AI Agent skills, including quality gates, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation set generation, and online behavior evaluation.
items.value: A deduplication and quality-control tool for scaled skill libraries

items.title: db-branch: ZFS-based second-level database branching
items.desc: Provides second-level database branching for AI Agents and CI, facilitating parallel experiments and rollbacks.
items.value: Isolation and rollback infrastructure for Agent database-write scenarios

items.title: "All AI-generated code should be open source" sparks HN debate
items.desc: An article argues AI-produced code should be open by default; on HN it hit 1054 points and 577 comments, with debate centered on license ownership, corporate secrets, and audit responsibility.
items.value: Copyright and compliance boundaries for AI code directly shape enterprise code policy

items.title: r/LocalLLaMA debates US move to block Chinese firms from remotely renting NVIDIA GPUs
items.desc: The community discusses the Commerce Department's proposed final rule and the Remote Access Security Act, arguing it will affect open-source models' access to overseas compute.
items.value: Compliance risk in remote compute rental affects open-source model training and inference deployment
